name: pandascrow-chrome-extension
description: Pandascrow in your browser: balances, escrows, quick payment links and invoices, alerts, and safe escrow checkout on online marketplaces.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && vite build -c vite.content.config.ts
scripts.build:dev: vite build --mode development && vite build -c vite.content.config.ts --mode development
scripts.zip: npm run build && cd dist && zip -qr ../pandascrow-extension.zip .
